method: Exact reviewed cadastral names intersected with the unchanged INAO Chambertin-Clos de Bèze boundary; metric diagnostics in EPSG:2154.
coverageNote: The BIVB names Clos-de-Bèze as the climat for this appellation. CLOS DE BEZE is audited inside the unchanged INAO Chambertin-Clos de Bèze feature; small boundary contacts with other lieux-dits are retained as unresolved cadastral context. No duplicate selectable layer or producer holdings are published, and the whole-cru outline remains the fallback.
